Why does the candle warmer lamp make the list?

  • Flame-free fragrance — safer around kids and pets

Who is the candle warmer lamp for?

Questions, answered

Do candles last longer with a warmer lamp?

Yes, noticeably. Melting from the top uses the wax evenly instead of burning a tunnel, so the same jar gives far more hours of scent.

Is it safer than burning candles?

There is no open flame, which is why it suits homes with kids, pets, or rental rules against candles. The bulb and melted wax still get warm, so treat it like a lamp.

What candles fit under it?

Most standard jar candles. The height adjusts, so taller and shorter jars both fit — check the jar's height against the lamp's range on the listing.

Does it have a timer?

Yes — this model has a built-in timer, plus adjustable height and 2 bulbs included.
